answer: Stop sybils with a juniper dune zenith: an agent stakes a bond for one dune crest. At zenith a juniper post casts a shadow on the crest; wardens measure it against the crest chart, voiding a crest whose shadow is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 crests at 18x: one juniper casts one shadow on one dune at one zenith, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents mark once, keep rights.
